title: SSC x Evans "Team Bag"
body_html:
What has one strap, two legs and maybe your name on it?

The bag you've been waiting for is finally here! We teamed up with our friends at Evans Golf Company to create our dream "team bag."

It's like a letterman's jacket, but for your clubs. Hop in the team van, we're going to state!

If you'd like to add personalization to your bag, fill out the field below! There is a 15 character limit. 

Bag Specs:

  • Under 4lbs
  • 36 inches in height 
  • 8 inches in diameter (at top and bottom)

Bags will be shipped by the Evans team -- they will take around two weeks to ship.

Because of the limited and custom nature of these bags, we cannot accept returns  -- but we know you'll love yours!

title: Double Seve Cooler Bag
body_html:
Made in the USA for SSC by Hudson Sutler. Built around half an inch of insulation and a durable welded waterproof liner (normally used for life rafts).

  • Dimensions: 14" long, 13" tall, 8" deep
  • Made in the USA
  • Material // Hard wearing 18 oz canvas exterior
  • Liner // Food Safe, Heat sealed 18oz. CPSIA Approved waterproof liner
  • Insulation // Half Inch Foam
  • Organization // Exterior front slip & zippered pocket
  • Handles // Heavy duty cotton webbing handles and shoulder strap
  • Components // Signature Zipper, Flip open lid for easy access
  • Volume // 1456cu inches / 24 L

title: Students of SSC Tote Bag
body_html:
The tote bag is SSC's preferred method of transporting materials in and out of the locker room. This particular tote bag comes adorned with a full suite of unique scout patches, a sign of a Scout Master.

  • Heavy duty 500D Cordura Camo Nylon
  • 15" height, 22" width, 6.5" deep
  • Two handles: 11.5" large handle drop, 4" small handle drop
  • Zippered interior pocket
  • Custom patches uniquely applied
  • Made in USA
